title: CI/CD Pipeline Automation
description: Built a complete CI/CD pipeline using Jenkins, Docker, and Kubernetes that automates testing, building, and deployment of microservices. Reduced deployment time by 70%.

title: Cloud Infrastructure on AWS
description: Designed and implemented a scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS using Terraform. Includes VPC, EC2, RDS, S3, and auto-scaling configurations with high availability.

title: Network Monitoring System
description: Developed a Python-based network monitoring system using SNMP and network automation tools. Real-time alerting and visualization of network health metrics.

title: Multi-Cloud Deployment Tool
description: A CLI tool for deploying applications across multiple cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP). Supports containerized workloads with unified deployment configuration.

title: Portfolio Website
description: This portfolio website — built with Vue 3 and Node.js/Express backend. Features a modern responsive design with dark/light themes.

title: Infrastructure as Code Framework
description: A comprehensive IaC framework using Ansible and Terraform for automating server provisioning, configuration management, and application deployment.
